method_definition: GPT-6 Astra Extra High uses the frozen Codex CLI text-only interface with reasoning_effort=xhigh to generate Blender Python scene code. Table 3 evaluates persistent recovery builds after the completed Table-2 raw tree was lost from its disclosed ephemeral /tmp migration target.
comparison_to_high: The prompt, output schema, Blender builder, Table-3 exporter, surface rules, Recast evaluator, specifications, logical seeds, failure policy, and aggregation are shared with GPT-6 Astra High; the intended model variable is reasoning_effort high versus xhigh.

structural_metrics.reason: The frozen final output has meshes and descriptive node names but no stable independent-instance graph, unified object roles, or native support edges.

source_recovery.reason: The verified /tmp migration target no longer exists and the logical Table-2 links are broken.
source_recovery.eligible: Only slots with scene_built=true in the frozen completed Table-2 formal audit
source_recovery.scientific_disclosure: The remote model does not support deterministic seeds. Recovery builds are fresh samples at the same frozen logical indexes and are not claimed to be the original Table-2 bytes. Any recovery generation/build failure is retained as an additional ITT failure.

coordinate_system: Blender meters, Z up, evaluation region centered at X=Y=0

navigation.aggregation: mean over the four seeds inside each specification, then mean over 25 specifications

blender.gpu_reason: Canonical mesh export performs no rendering or neural inference; Blender dependency-graph and Recast operations are CPU-only
